system.description:
Traversing the wild spaces of the world often casts you into various roles on the battlefield, and with experience and training you learn to adopt styles which fit your particular environments, targets, and weaponry. Choose one from the following list of stances. Once per long rest you can assume this stance. If you choose to assume your stance after that free use, you must expend 2 exertion points. In battle, these stances use your bonus action to assume.

At 5th level, you select a second stance from this list. The damage bonus of each stance is of the same type as the weapon you use for the attack.

Coordinated Assault

When you and a companion, animal or otherwise, act on the same initiative to attack the same target, you each gain +1d6 damage to one successful weapon attack. If you have extra attack, you and your companion each get +1d6 on two successful weapon attacks. In addition, you gain expertise on animal handling checks.

Guerilla

While you are in three quarters cover or are obscured, you gain +1d6 damage on every successful weapon attack you make. In addition, you gain expertise on Stealth checks in natural environments.

Implacable

Choose a creature you can see within 60ft when you take this stance. You gain +1d6 damage on every successful weapon attack you make against that target. You also gain expertise on checks made to track or locate your target. Alternatively, you can mark a specific creature based on their tracks or a bounty poster, at any range.

Skirmisher

While in the skirmisher stance, if you move at least 15ft before using the attack action, you gain +1d6 damage on every successful weapon attack you make during the attack action, and any bonus action attacks. In addition, you gain expertise when you parry, increasing the d4 to a d6.
